entries.02041b3721dd1097: This business manufactures and sells printed matter such as continuous forms, sheet forms, specialty paper, uniform slips, envelopes and brochures. In connection with the reorganization of its factories, production is being consolidated, and the company plans to shift products previously produced on printing presses to digital printers from the perspective of environmental impact and power saving. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,462 million.
entries.09c3ed9550601b46: This business manufactures and sells printed matter such as continuous forms, sheet forms, specialty paper, uniform slips, envelopes and brochures.
entries.2294e181691a4536: A printing-related company whose main activities are the manufacture and sale of printed matter such as business forms and data printing services.
entries.3bef8541a74c0f0f: Companies that require printing of forms and notices
entries.5c710d5c1902d92f: This is a data printing service, including data output by high-speed printers and mailing. The company aims to capture demand arising from changes in laws and systems such as the Family Register Act and My Number health insurance cards, and to strengthen initiatives with local governments, leveraging its track record and trust in handling personal information. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥4,696 million.
entries.5e752b91eda4ad8d: This is a printing-related business mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of business forms and data printing services. The company has a single segment for this business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,743 million.
entries.8f239f04453eb137: This is a data printing service, including data output by high-speed printers and mailing.
entries.cedb18185e4817fb: This is an outsourcing business. It provides services that comprehensively combine business form printing and information processing technologies, as well as digitization (scanning) services for past documents and materials. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥452 million.
entries.e1c1b56950da304a: This is a printing-related business mainly engaged in the manufacture and sale of business forms and data printing services.
entries.e42d01209f1f299d: A business of system development related to information processing, including WEB system development, operation and maintenance, and database and server construction. It aims to establish a recurring business that continues to provide services after products are delivered. Sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥132 million.
